# GitHub Actions pins

All third-party Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs. The adjacent version
comments are update hints; Dependabot opens reviewed updates rather than moving
the workflow implicitly.

Pins were resolved from each publisher's official GitHub tag reference through
the GitHub API on 2026-08-17. Review updates against these upstream sources:

- <https://github.com/actions/checkout>
- <https://github.com/actions/setup-python>
- <https://github.com/actions/github-script>
- <https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact>
- <https://github.com/actions/download-artifact>
- <https://github.com/dorny/test-reporter>
- <https://github.com/docker/setup-qemu-action>
- <https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action>
- <https://github.com/docker/build-push-action>
- <https://github.com/docker/login-action>
- <https://github.com/aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials>
- <https://github.com/github/codeql-action>
